summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and then invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js — or invokes an already-installed `bun` directly on that file if one is on PATH. math_init.js is a ~727KB `@bun-cjs` bundle whose top-level structure is a large numeric/string array plus a shift-based string-array rotator with hex-named identifiers (obfuscator.io / string-array-rotation shape); its contents are not human-readable and bear no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a validated timestring input component). Because execution runs under a freshly downloaded Bun rather than Node, the payload bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners and executes arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
